title: Sidebar folder assignment has no capability-catalog row, so it is unreachable from the control API, MCP and plugins
description:
Split out of THE-696 (2026-09-29). THE-696 delivered the CLI (`thegn wt folder <worktree> <name>` / `--clear`, `thegn wt new --folder`). It did not add a capability-catalog row, so folder assignment exists only on the CLI, while CLAUDE.md requires: "One capability catalog. Control API, gRPC, CLI verbs, MCP tools and plugin host calls project `thegn_core::capability::CATALOG`."

A catalog row is all-or-nothing: it requires the routed request/handler, the generated wire/schema coverage (`docs/api/control-v1.json`), and surface coverage for each declared surface; `test/surface-gaps-ratchet.txt` is shrink-only, so a row landed without every declared surface makes the ratchet grow and is refused.

## Scope
Project the operation that already exists in the DB and CLI:
- `ensure_folder` / `set_worktree_folder` / `set_worktree_folder_if_identity` (`crates/thegn-core/src/db_workspace.rs`) are the primitives — no new SQL, no schema change. Reuse the CLI's helpers in `crates/thegn-host/src/cmd/wt.rs` (`check_folder_fileable`, `file_registered_worktree`, `register_and_file_worktree`, `clear_folder_if_registered`) rather than re-implementing.
- Match the scope requirements of the nearest existing worktree-mutation capability.
- Assignment stays identity-checked; `set_worktree_folder_if_identity` is an UPDATE (returns false for an absent row) — a false must surface as an error. Names are repo-scoped, trimmed and case-insensitive, but the identity helper compares the persisted name exactly.

## Acceptance criteria
- A `folders.*` capability row exists with an implemented (not reserved) kind.
- Reachable from every surface the row declares (control API, MCP, plugin host calls), not only the CLI.
- `docs/api/control-v1.json` regenerated; the control-schema snapshot test passes (`THEGN_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1 cargo test -p thegn-svc --test control_schema`).
- `test/surface-gaps-ratchet.txt` does not grow.
- Clearing is reachable and does not delete the folder.
- An absent worktree row, a deleted/renamed folder, and a cross-repo folder each produce an error, not a silent no-op.
